hypotheses.K0_rank64_transfer: A position-stratified rank-64 discovery gradient basis reaches at least 0.50 median held-out cosine.
hypotheses.K1_rank128_transfer: Rank 128 reaches at least 0.70 median held-out cosine.
hypotheses.K2_rank256_transfer: The full 256-gradient discovery span reaches at least 0.85 median held-out cosine.
hypotheses.K3_rank256_contribution_transfer: Rank-256 projected delta-times-gradient vectors reach at least 0.80 median cosine.
hypotheses.K4_rank256_support_transfer: Projected and exact top-64 positive supports have median Jaccard at least 0.40.
hypotheses.K5_rank256_leverage_transfer: Projected supports retain at least 70% of exact top-64 first-order leverage in the median.
hypotheses.K6_stratification_materially_improves_ra: The stratified rank-32 basis improves median gradient cosine by at least 0.10 over the original rank-32 result of 0.252.
